csv_project_name: AE for Yaman Park Swimming Facility Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cortland (the City ) is soliciting proposals from qualified and experienced professional architectural and engineering (A/E) firms to provide comprehensive design, engineering, bidding, and construction-phase services for improvements at Yaman Park, funded through the New York State Water Infrastructure Improvement Act Swimming Facilities Program (NY SWIMS). The City of Cortland proposes a full renovation of the seasonal use outdoor swimming facilities at Yaman Park, originally constructed more than 70 years ago. The goal is to transform an aging and inaccessible site into a safe, inclusive, and modern waterfront recreation area. The swimming facility is a 4.5 acre man-made pond/lake with all the amenities that typically accommodate a public swimming facility of this type, including a bathhouse with restrooms and showers, lifeguard area, pavilions, and a beach.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
